## Submission checklist

- [ ] The `submitter` block in `submission.yaml` has a name and contact filled in.
- [ ] The bundle was built from the GPTNT release recorded in its provenance.
- [ ] This PR adds only new, direct bundle folders under `submissions/`.
- [ ] The bundle was generated with `gptnt submission new` and not hand-edited (only the `submitter` block is filled by hand).
